title: Studio: All metadata lists show a base's .custom items marked "customized" or "added", with an "only customizations" filter and per-type counts
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 (P3, cut 2026-11-01 on the maintainer's 「四项提速措施全部按推荐执行」, schedule reviewed) · plan of record: ADR-0146 Rollout P3 "N-26 the metadata directory into Studio (D1)", the half that waits on N-15 (schedule review table: N-26b ← N-15, N-26a). ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #28411, #28561

Part of #28236 (P3, child **N-26b**) · governs: ADR-0146 D3 ("On top, one surface": the pair's items in the same list, marked "customization", an override marked with the base it overrides, "only customizations"), D2 (the customization list, from served facts), D1 (the All metadata area) · lane: `domain:ui` · size: M.

**Why it waits.** The marks are N-15's served facts (#28411: the base's `.custom` overrides, extensions and counts). The surface they go on is N-26a's All metadata area.

**Business reason.** In Studio's All metadata area for HotCRM, an administrator browsing translations or email templates should see which ones they changed and which they added. They should also be able to filter to just those, in the same place the pillars show it. Without marks, the catalog cannot answer "what did we change on HotCRM" for the types the pillars do not cover.

**Measured (`35b178bd0a`).**
- `metadata-admin/DirectoryPage.tsx` tiles show label, machine name, an item count scoped to the `?package=` package (`countsByType`, :149–156, :329), and writable/overlay badges (:187–191). Nothing marks a customization.
- `ResourceListPage.tsx` classifies a row's source from its `_packageId` (:111–140, the Source badge at :875–904). It lists the scoped package only, so a base's list does not show the pair's items.
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts:94#customizationPackageId` and :111 `customizationBasePackageId` name the pair and its base.
- N-15's route and field names: not landed, not verified. N-19's mark component: not landed (sibling card).

**Wanted.**
1. With a base open in the All metadata area, each type list shows the base's items and the pair's items in one list. A pair item N-15 lists as an override is marked "customized", naming the base. Any other pair item is marked "added". Nothing is computed client-side (no diff, no `basedOn` verdict, D2/D6).
2. An "only customizations" filter on each list, from the same read.
3. Each directory tile shows the type's customization count. The directory header shows the base's total, both from N-15's served counts. Extensions are counted on the object tile.
4. A failed or pending N-15 read draws no mark and no number, never "0", with the server's sentence on failure. A base with no pair draws no marks.
5. One mark component for the whole console. Whichever of N-19 and this card lands first creates it, and the other reuses it.
6. In the cross-package leg, rows of a pair are labelled with their base (`customizationBasePackageId`).

**Tests.** Base + pair fixture with one overridden translation, one added email template and one extension field:
- the translation list marks the override "customized (HotCRM)" and the filter shows it alone;
- the email-template list marks the added item;
- the object tile counts the extension;
- a failed read draws no mark;
- a base without a pair is unchanged.

**Release safety.** Safe on its own: read-only marks over a served read (`Blocked-by: #28411`) on N-26a's area. Nothing is written or removed.

**Not here.** The area itself (N-26a). Pillar rail marks and the switcher fold (N-19). Landing counts (N-24). The simplified translation and email-template editors (N-25). Redirects (N-28).

**Dedupe.** Searched `only customizations filter`, `customized added mark metadata directory`: only #28411 and closed history.

Links back: #28236, #28411, ADR-0146 D1, D2, D3, D6.
